page.overview:
What is The Final Duel?

Story 9: Ceremonial Battle is the final arc in the Yu-Gi-Oh! anime. In the 4Kids Entertainment dub, the Pharaoh's Memories and Ceremonial Battle arcs are collectively referred to as Dawn of the Duel.

It features the final Duel between Yugi Muto and Atem.

Winners are in bold. The last three Duels were briefly shown during the ending credits of the final episode. They were cut from the 4Kids Entertainment dub.
